findings.title: Conversation bounds do not define a stop at the collection cap
findings.consequence: The design caps retained pages/comments/text, but does not say that load-more stops issuing source requests when the 10-page/1,000-comment or 8 MiB limit is reached. A caller can continue fetching and discarding pages, so the stated retained-view limit does not bound cumulative source and application work or define reliable cursor/partial-coverage behavior at the cap.
findings.fix: Define the pagination budget as a hard per-view/source-read cap, including the response bytes fetched, and stop requesting pages when any cap is reached. Specify how the cursor and explicit partial-coverage state are exposed at that point; if continuation is supported, make it a separately bounded read rather than silently fetching and discarding pages.

dimensions.accepted_intent_and_scope: The plan retains ordinary issue read-only context and the original acceptance, without command, journal, or scheduler scope.
dimensions.readiness_and_authority: Readiness evidence records owner authorization and the original acceptance; this review does not treat implementation or source consent as complete.
dimensions.source_and_lifecycle_contract: The design adopts the Lighthouse wire contract and shared lifecycle, avoids a policy fork, and requires exact run/revision/attempt correlation rather than recency.
dimensions.authority_and_isolation: The plan gates reads on configured-repository/user authority, separates transient stale data from authority loss, and removes prior data on loss or identity change.
dimensions.evidence_and_artifact_safety: Malformed, unsupported, expired, oversized, inaccessible, spoofed, and incomplete evidence is represented explicitly; artifact byte/member/type limits and bounded stream handling are specified.
dimensions.conversation_bounds: Needs changes: retained-view bounds exist, but no hard stop prevents further page fetches after those caps.
dimensions.presentation_and_accessibility: Safe Markdown, keyboard access, narrow phone layout, long-conversation and unavailable-evidence checks are planned.
dimensions.gates_and_dependencies: Real connected-user/source acceptance, final current-head CI, independent Done review, and the #49 dependency gate remain later gates; production is separate.
